criteria.directSun: observer sunlight passes if any source indicates sunlit sky
criteria.observerDirectRadiation: Open-Meteo direct_radiation >= 120 W/m2 is one observer sunlight source
criteria.observerSunlight: GO if either Open-Meteo cloud or direct radiation passes; cloud threshold < 60%
criteria.rainOppositeSun: radar return in anti-solar fan 5-48 km from observer
criteria.rainPointSunlight: reported for diagnosis only; old gate was direct_radiation >= 80 W/m2 and cloud_cover < 75%

source.satelliteSunlight: GOES DSRF + GOES ACMC hierarchy prototype
source.sunlight: Open-Meteo cloud_cover/direct_radiation fallback; satellite artifact overrides this when fresh
